tasks.title: Package scaffold, packaging wiring, config + profiles
tasks.acceptance: import say_transcribe works core-only; speech_features tests still pass; say-transcribe --help; PROFILES defined; ruff clean

tasks.title: Working model + JSON v2 exporter
tasks.acceptance: to_json_v2_dict(Recording) accepted by speech_features.validate_document; round-trips via load_document; NFC; byte-stable; overwrite guard

tasks.title: CHAT subset exporter
tasks.acceptance: load_document(.cha) has no UNSUPPORTED_CHAT_TIER on known data; [A-Z]{3} codes; filler/fragment kinds round-trip; %mor/%gra aligned; errors without @Media

tasks.title: Audio ingest wrapper
tasks.acceptance: wraps speech_features.audio.read_wav to 16 kHz mono float; stereo downmix; non-PCM -> UNSUPPORTED_AUDIO; file SHA-256; no waveform in logs/repr

tasks.title: Forced-alignment spike (timeboxed)
tasks.acceptance: SPIKE-forced-alignment.md with per-backend mean/max token-time error, tone-mark pass/fail, and a go/no-go recommendation; reference clip + alignment committed; no PII audio

tasks.title: ASR stage + engine registry + PhoWhisper engine
tasks.acceptance: FakeASREngine drives stage with no network/download; AsrResult -> working model with language=vie; missing transformers -> MISSING_OPTIONAL_DEPENDENCY; ENGINES read-only with 3 ASR names; no audio in logs

tasks.title: Rule-based segmentation stage
tasks.acceptance: segments finite/ordered within duration; deterministic; one LLM_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE warning; tokens preserved, no whitespace re-split

tasks.title: Vietnamese word-grouping stage (underthesea)
tasks.acceptance: multi-syllable words share word_id; NFC + tone + d/d-stroke preserved; no str.split on VN text; FakeSegmenter path; word_id unique per segment, never cross-segment

tasks.title: Pipeline runner + provenance + JSON-slice wiring
tasks.acceptance: first JSON slice with fakes exports a validating doc using provisional ASR segments; a raising stage -> one error issue, run continues; provenance JSON-serialisable with no transcript text / no secrets; per-stage timing; deterministic

tasks.title: CLI transcribe / engines / diagnose
tasks.acceptance: transcribe --profile lite --format json -> say-features validate exit 0; --format both writes .cha + provenance.json; diagnose shows secrets as set/not set only; overwrite w/o --force exits 2; out-of-CWD exits 2; --single-speaker is explicit

tasks.title: LLMBackend protocol + Ollama backend
tasks.acceptance: FakeLLM for unit tests, no real HTTP; Ollama backend sends format+options to a stub, returns parsed JSON; connection error -> LLMUnavailableError; endpoint/token never in logs or provenance; deterministic with seed+temp0

tasks.title: LLM segmentation stage + rule fallback
tasks.acceptance: FakeLLM canned segmentation matches expected boundaries/terminators/casing; no backend -> byte-identical to T7 + issue; NFC; no token add/drop; prompt sha256 in provenance; malformed JSON -> issue + rule fallback

tasks.title: Diarization stage + DiarizerBackend + pyannote
tasks.acceptance: FakeDiarizer assigns turns without importing pyannote; role IDs PAR/EXA with empty name, no synthesised names; single-speaker bypass emits no issue; pyannote import error -> one DIARIZATION_UNAVAILABLE warning; no HF token logged

tasks.title: Forced-alignment stage
tasks.acceptance: FakeAligner refines without torch; refined times monotonic within segment bounds; degrade path keeps ASR timings + one FORCED_ALIGNMENT_UNAVAILABLE; tone marks unchanged; deterministic; implementation starts only after CP1.5

tasks.title: default profile wiring + CLI default
tasks.acceptance: no --profile runs 5-stage default; output has speaker_id + refined/degraded times + word_id; say-features validate exit 0 on .json and .cha; runs and validates with all optional backends absent (3 *_UNAVAILABLE issues); integration test passes

tasks.title: Disfluency stage (LLM, opt-in)
tasks.acceptance: FakeLLM tags -> tokens get kind filler/fragment/retracing/revision after CHAT reload; JSON v2 still validates; absent from lite/default; no token add/drop; prompt sha256 in provenance

tasks.title: Grouped UD morphosyntax JSON + speech_features compatibility
tasks.acceptance: FakeParser writes representative-only UPOS/lemma/dep annotations; JSON validates; incomplete layers preserve per-feature warnings; full/--stage only

tasks.title: Conditional CHAT morphosyntax projection
tasks.acceptance: complete paired %mor/%gra projection passes grouped-word fixture, CLAN CHECK when available, and SAY reload; incomplete pair omitted with CHAT_MORPHOSYNTAX_UNAVAILABLE

tasks.title: full profile wiring + --stage override
tasks.acceptance: --profile full runs 7 stages in SPEC order; --stage asr,wordgroup runs exactly those and exports a valid sparse doc; unknown stage/profile exits 2; SPEC section 11 criteria 1-11 each have a passing test

tasks.title: Determinism / provenance / redaction test sweep
tasks.acceptance: byte-identical .json/.cha across two full runs with fakes; provenance grep finds no transcript words and no hf_/bearer patterns; diagnose redaction; --force and out-of-CWD guards tested at exit 2; documented non-determinism listed in provenance

tasks.title: Package docs + research-only disclaimer + README
tasks.acceptance: --help shows research-only disclaimer; USAGE.md covers local-only guarantee, human-review step, stable issue codes, exit codes; README points to say-transcribe; Q9 records no generated stub and explicit --single-speaker; pytest + ruff + git diff --check clean

tasks.title: Corpus intake: format probe + continuous-recording split + manifest
tasks.acceptance: 5 continuous WAVs probed for real sampwidth/rate/peak/packing and split into 55 per-task clips + a SAY batch manifest; manifest and filenames carry only recording_id and relative paths, never a participant name

tasks.title: Reference transcripts for a held-out gold subset
tasks.acceptance: hand-corrected CHAT/JSON reference transcripts exist for a held-out subset of T21's clips; each reference validates via speech_features.load_document

tasks.title: Eval harness: WER/CER + CHAT-validity scorer
tasks.acceptance: WER/CER and CHAT-validity pass-rate computed per manifest row against T22 references; the written report contains aggregate scores and counts only, no reference-transcript text

tasks.title: ASR decode hardening (hallucination mitigation)
tasks.acceptance: VAD gate + condition_on_previous_text=False + compression-ratio/logprob/no-speech thresholds + temperature fallback wired into the ASR stage config; T23 harness records a measured WER/hallucination delta vs the unhardened baseline

tasks.title: Preprocess stage-group scaffold + branch-invariant test
tasks.acceptance: PreprocessConfig and --preprocess/--denoiser/--keep-preprocessed flags wired; diagnose reports sox/ffmpeg/GSM as found/not found only, never a resolved path; a test proves say-features extract/validate is never invoked with a preprocessed-suffixed path

tasks.title: loudness_norm stage (ffmpeg two-pass EBU R128)
tasks.acceptance: two-pass ffmpeg loudnorm with linear=true only; same input + config produces byte-identical output audio and byte-identical measured I/LRA/TP/thresh scalars across two runs; ships enabled by default

tasks.title: vad stage (Silero VAD, ASR/diarization input only)
tasks.acceptance: Silero VAD speech intervals feed only ASR chunking / diarization turn hints; a test fails if any field it writes collides with speech_features.features.acoustic.timing's time_pause_* / time_voiced_segment_* names; ships enabled by default

tasks.title: Routing spike: measure channel_norm / denoise WER delta (timeboxed)
tasks.acceptance: SPIKE-preprocess-routing.md reports aggregate WER per condition (channel_norm on/off, denoise on/off) on T22's gold set with a pre-registered decision rule and one go/no-go recommendation per step; no transcript excerpt or participant identifier in the doc

tasks.title: channel_norm stage (sox GSM chain), default off
tasks.acceptance: sox chain (mono -> GSM FR 13kbps -> decode -> 16k -> compand 8:1 -> bandpass 200-3400Hz) implemented and off by default per the T28 gate; the spec records the recorder-hardware-change re-evaluation trigger (F3)

tasks.title: denoise stage (Denoiser protocol), default off
tasks.acceptance: Denoiser protocol with deepfilternet (default impl) and ffmpeg_afftdn (fallback impl); stage ships off by default per the T28 gate; FullSubNet stays a named, deferred option behind the same protocol

tasks.title: chatter subprocess CHAT validation
tasks.acceptance: say-transcribe additionally validates exported CHAT output via a chatter subprocess call; a missing chatter binary produces one CHATTER_UNAVAILABLE warning, never a hard failure, and export still completes

tasks.title: Word-level confidence surfacing + review queue
tasks.acceptance: ASR word-level confidence is written to AnnotationLayer.confidence; a review-queue report lists tokens below a configurable threshold by position, in aggregate terms only, with no transcript text beyond the flagged token
